name: Scyther

1.name: U-turn
1.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

name: Pineco
flavour_text: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.

name: Volbeat

1.name: Confuse Ray
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavour_text: It flashes the light on its rear to communicate with other Volbeat. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

name: Illumise

1.name: Mental Crush
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Confused, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. There are scholars who research the meaning of these signs.

name: Phantump
flavour_text: This Pokémon came to be when the spirit of a deceased child possessed a tree stump. It now wanders the forest searching for friends.

name: Trevenant

1.name: Rumble Stomp
1.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.

flavour_text: Trevenant is very kind to Pokémon living in the forest. It doesn’t even care if these Pokémon take up residence in the greenery on its head.

name: Charmander
flavour_text: If Charmander is healthy, the flame on the tip of its tail will burn vigorously and won’t go out even if it gets a bit wet.

name: Charmeleon

ability.name: Ignition
ability.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may take a [R] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to your Active [R] Pokémon.

flavour_text: It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents to battle against. Its aggression will not be quelled if it doesn’t win.

1.name: Raging Blaze
1.effect: If this Pokémon's remaining HP is 110 or less, this attack does 80 more damage.

name: Ponyta

1.name: Singe
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

flavour_text: If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

name: Rapidash

1.name: Overdrive Smash
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Overdrive Smash attack does +30 damage.

flavour_text: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd’s pace and direction of travel.

name: Magmar
flavour_text: Wavering flames similar to those of the sun appear on the surface of this Pokémon’s body.

name: Magmortar

1.name: Thundering Volcano
1.effect: If Electivire is on your Bench, this attack also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: They dwell in volcanic craters. It’s said that only a single pair of Magmortar will inhabit any given volcano.

name: Paldean Tauros

1.name: Take Down
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavour_text: People call this kind of Tauros the Blaze Breed due to the hot air it snorts from its nostrils. Its three tails are intertwined.

name: Slowpoke
flavour_text: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

1.name: Laundry-Go-Round
1.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack also does 20 damage for each heads to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

name: Lapras

1.name: Raging Freeze
1.effect: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavour_text: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

name: Piplup
flavour_text: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.

name: Prinplup

1.name: Water Splash
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

name: Empoleon

1.name: Emperor’s Strike
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has more remaining HP than this Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will mercilessly decimate anything that threatens the safety of its colony.

name: Phione

1.name: Aqua Turbo
1.effect: Take a [W] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched [W] Pokémon.

flavour_text: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Raichu

1.name: Thunder
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

flavour_text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

name: Electabuzz
flavour_text: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.

name: Electivire

1.name: Incendiary Thunder
1.effect: If Magmortar is on your Bench, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavour_text: This Pokémon presses the tips of its tails onto an opponent and instantly sends over 20,000 volts of high-voltage electricity through them.

name: Electrike

1.name: Quick Attack
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

1.name: Lightning Accelerator
1.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each point you have gotten.

name: Drowzee

1.name: Hypnosis
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

name: Hypno

1.name: Hypnoblast
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

name: Mew

1.name: Miraculous Memory
1.effect: 1 attack from among the Pokémon in your opponent's hand and deck is chosen at random, and you use the chosen attack as this attack.

flavour_text: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

name: Spoink
flavour_text: Using its tail like a spring, it keeps its heart beating by bouncing constantly. If it stops, it dies.

name: Grumpig

1.name: Swaying Dance
1.effect: If your opponent has exactly 2, 4, or 6 cards in their hand, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes’ minds.

name: Diglett

1.name: Slight Intrusion
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavour_text: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

name: Dugtrio
flavour_text: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Groudon

1.name: Gaia Blast
1.effect: Discard 2 random Energy from among the Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

flavour_text: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

name: Hawlucha

1.name: Take Down
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavour_text: Hawlucha live quietly without flocking together. They fight constantly with their natural enemies: noisy groups of Primeape.

name: Gastly
flavour_text: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

name: Haunter

1.name: Spin Turn
1.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: In total darkness, where nothing is visible, Haunter lurks, silently stalking its next victim.

1.name: Labyrinth of Shadows
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Trainer cards from their hand.

name: Darkrai

ability.name: Bad Dreams
ability.effect: At the end of each turn, if your opponent's Active Pokémon is Asleep, do 20 damage to that Pokémon.

1.name: Dark Slumber
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

name: Trubbish
flavour_text: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

name: Garbodor
flavour_text: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

name: Zorua

1.name: Surprise Attack
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Zoroark

1.name: Energy Crush
1.effect: This attack does 20 damage for each Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

name: Morpeko

1.name: Energizer Wheel
1.effect: Move 2 [D] Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Hunger has disrupted this Pokémon’s hormonal balance. The Electric-type energy stored in its cheek sacs has turned into Dark-type energy.

name: Forretress

1.name: Enormous Explosion
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 100 damage to itself and 50 damage to all Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

flavour_text: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

1.name: Bullet Slugger
1.effect: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 50 more damage.

name: Kartana
flavour_text: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Varoom
flavour_text: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

name: Revavroom

ability.name: Metal Transport
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may switch your Active [M] Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

name: Dratini

1.name: Tail Strike
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavour_text: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.

name: Dragonair

1.name: Sky’s Blessing
1.effect: Take a [W] and a [L] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach them to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It is called the divine Pokémon. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes.

name: Dragonite

1.name: Dragon Wave
1.effect: Discard a [W] and a [L] Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

name: Axew
flavour_text: If you see peculiar teeth marks on boulders or trees, it means an Axew is likely living nearby.

name: Fraxure
flavour_text: Fraxure uses its thick tusks to neatly cut prey into two portions—one to eat now and one to save for later.

name: Haxorus

1.name: Frenzied Blade
1.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

flavour_text: It overwhelms enemies with its prized tusks, which are sharp enough to cut through a metal transmission tower in one strike.

name: Druddigon

1.name: Clutch
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavour_text: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

name: Jigglypuff
flavour_text: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

name: Wigglytuff
flavour_text: The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels so good that anyone who feels it can’t stop touching it.

name: Miltank

1.name: Rout
1.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

name: Chatot

1.name: Spinning Draw
1.effect: Draw a card.

flavour_text: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

1.name: Play Rough
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavour_text: These Pokémon like things neat and tidy. They are always sweeping and dusting their habitat, using their tails as brooms.

name: Cinccino
flavour_text: The oil that seeps from its body is really smooth. For people troubled by bad skin, this oil is an effective treatment.

ability.effect: This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
